verdict.rationale: RUN documents its own journal-entry export to QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic file, which covers getting payroll journal data into a ledger. Nothing shows an agent can trigger or consume that export programmatically, and API Central is described only generically, not as exposing RUN journal data. missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for RUN payroll journal data, evidence of agent or programmatic access to the export, documented reconciliation or matching logic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger

citations.quote: Export journal entries from ADP into QuickBooks®, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic output file without re-keying data.
developers to automate HR processes through integration for accurate, real-time data sharing, eliminating file-based imports and exports.
